_comment: R0 scripted rc controls. Layout at RngRun 1, outageThreshold -1000: IMSIs 1,2 on cell 3 (gNB 3); IMSIs 3,4,5,6 on cell 2 (gNB 2). Steps are 10 periods apart (one handover takes ~2 ms of simulated time). via = the E2 node whose agent receives the control: 1 = the eNB (MN), 2 and 3 = gNB agents. key = N5 cell key %08X%02X (gNB id, cell id). Each control is stamped afterSeq = step by the pacer's `steps` gating.
